## About Kraa

Kraa is a web-based markdown editor from a three-person team in Switzerland. The platform combines notes, documents, blog publishing, and real-time chat. Unlike Notion and Google Docs, the infrastructure runs on Swiss servers and no account is strictly required.

## Highlights

 ✓ Markdown editor with live preview
 ✓ Real-time collaboration with cursor tracking
 ✓ In-line chat widget directly in the document
 ✓ No login required to write
 ✓ Servers in Switzerland

## Why European?

 → Swiss team based in Switzerland
 → Swiss data protection law, outside US CLOUD Act reach
 → Servers in Switzerland
 → Built with ProseMirror, TipTap, and Svelte

## Pricing

Free during public beta · Pro plan announced for 2026

## Frequently asked questions about Kraa

What is Kraa and what is it used for? + 

Kraa is a web-based markdown editor developed by a three-person Swiss team and released in 2025. The app combines notes, collaborative documents, blog publishing, and a chat in one interface. Features include markdown with live preview, real-time collaboration with cursor tracking, in-line chat, and a sharing system with customizable access rights. No registration is required to start.

  Does Kraa run on European infrastructure? + [...] What distinguishes Kraa from Notion? + 

Kraa is Swiss and focuses on a minimalist markdown editor with chat, Notion is US-American and offers a database-centric platform with extensive block structures. Kraa does not require a login to write, Notion requires an account. Notion belongs to a US company and is subject to the CLOUD Act, Kraa uses Swiss servers. Notion has a significantly larger feature set, Kraa focuses on the writing process without distraction.

There is an abundance of choice when it comes to text editors, but they all tend to fall into one of two categories. Either their interface is too cluttered and bursting with features – or they are too simple and limiting.  
  
With Kraa, we tried to do the impossible. Create an editor that's pleasant to use, simple, clutter-free. And yet – it can take anything you throw at it.  
  
This update also includes a voice control feature unlike anything you have used before.
